'''Gratina Renliss''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who co-founded [[House Renliss]], an all-female chapter of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], with her sister [[Jalindas Renliss]].
